info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: asya DAtoH viDiliNlakArasya prakriyAyAm Sap-vikaraRasya lukaM vinA api (BvAdigaRasadfSAni) rUpARi sidDyanti, tAdfSAni ca mADavIyaDAtuvfttO pAWitAni santi; ataSca atra api dIyante . etezAm samarTanArTam gaRakAryamanityam iti kAcit pariBAzA api svIkftA asti .

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: sAMsa lenA, SvAsocCvAsa karanA, jInA, jIte rahanA
